entities.name: Henri-Pons de Thiard de Bissy

entities.summary: Henri-Pons de Thiard de Bissy was a French priest who was Bishop of Toul from 1687 to 1704, Bishop of Meaux from 1704 to 1737, and Cardinal from 1715 to 1737.
